selector.rationale: The patient has confirmed SARS-CoV-2 infection and bilateral ground-glass opacities, which are characteristic of COVID-19-associated coagulopathy. Additionally, the patient's coagulation profile and clinical presentation are consistent with this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Sepsis
rejected.why: The patient's temperature is 34 °C, which is not consistent with sepsis.

rejected.label: Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome
rejected.why: The patient's PaO₂ is 78.2 mmHg, which is not consistent with ARDS.

rejected.label: Heparin-induced thrombocytopenia
rejected.why: The patient was just started on prophylactic-dose unfractionated heparin, making it unlikely to be the cause of thrombocytopenia.

rejected.label: Disseminated Intravascular Coagulation
rejected.why: While the patient has an elevated APTT and D-dimer, the INR is only 1.35, which is not consistent with DIC.
